rationale: Verbal-noun formation on ⲉⲙⲁϩⲧⲉ 'grasp, hold fast, exercise authority' (in glossary, attested line 5 of this page). The ⲏⲙ- onset may be a Lyc. action-noun prefix. Functions in line 23 as the cosmic 'seizure' that is interwoven with the rising of the three wheels in the King of Glory's watch. Tentative; flagged for parallels.

Possibly ⲭⲉ- (infinitive marker) + ϩⲁⲃⲉⲃⲉ a reduplicated form on ⲃⲉⲃⲉ 'gush forth' (already in glossary). Used in line 13 of Sin's upward surge against the Ambassador's icon. Alternative: ⲭⲉ as Lyc. ϫⲉ 'that.' Tentative.

Recurs lines 10, 11, 26 in cosmographic schema of the Omophoros: 'the four ⲧⲱϭⲥ̄' below the great middle land, 'the lower ⲧⲱϭⲥ̄' that dry up. Likely Lyc. body-anatomy term for foot/limb-joint, mapping the Omophoros's anatomy to the lower four lands. Possibly cognate with ⲧⲱⲣⲉ/ⲧⲁⲱⲣⲉ-stem.

proposed_english: as a sovereign / as a lord
rationale: Compound ⲛ̄ϩⲟⲛ ('as, in the manner of') + ⲛ̄ⲭⲁⲓ̈ⲥ ('a lord' — ⲭⲁⲓ̈ⲥ already in glossary as Lyc. for ⲡϫⲟⲉⲓⲥ). Used predicatively at line 8-9 of the Omophoros's authority. Possible alternative parsing: ⲱⲱⲛ + ⲭⲁⲓ̈ⲥ doublet.

Orthographic variant of Greek παρεμβολή (cf. ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲙⲡⲟⲗⲏ and pl. ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲙⲡⲟⲗⲁⲩⲉ already in glossary). At line 29 designates the entire 5-watch cosmographic structure that the apostle has just unfolded as a martial-architectural 'array.' Variant spelling worth recording.
